# Cairo Cosmo Center (مركز القاهرة الطبي لجراحات التجميل والليزر)
> https://cairocosmo.online

## About
Cairo Cosmo Center is a premier medical aesthetics and laser center in Egypt, featuring specialized university consultants in plastic surgery, dermatology, laser hair removal, and medical skincare.

## Branches
- Sheraton Heliopolis: 11 Adib Ali Adham St.
- Dokki: 7 Al-Sadd Al-Aali St.
- 6th of October: 30 Central Axis.
- Mansoura: 8 El-Gomhoureya St.
- Shubra: 145 Shubra St.

## Core Services
- Laser Hair Removal (Candela GentleLase Pro & Elite Plus)
- Botox & Dermal Fillers (Allergan, Juvederm)
- Skin Rejuvenation (HIFU, Fractional Laser, Hydrafacial, Chemical Peeling)
- Hair Restoration & Mesotherapy (PRP, Stem Cells, Hair Transplant)
- Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery
